name: registry-watch
author: sparkleware
description: Daily digest of new packs added to the Sparkleware registry. Stay current on community skills without manually browsing the site.
long_description_md:
## What it does

Fetches the live Sparkleware registry snapshot once a day, diffs it against a local last-seen file in your Aeon `memory/` directory, and prints a holographic digest of any newly-added packs.

## Why

The registry grows over time as contributors submit new packs (PR-based) or as the daily auto-discovery crawl picks up repos tagged `aeon-skill-pack`. Without this skill, you'd have to manually check the website to know what's new. With it, the digest shows up in your morning terminal session.

## How it works

1. `curl` the live `packs-snapshot.json` from `github.com/sparkleware/sparkleware`
2. `jq` diff against the snapshot in `memory/sparkleware-seen.json`
3. Print sparkle ASCII banner + new-pack summary
4. Persist updated snapshot for next run

Idempotent — running twice in a row without registry changes prints "no new packs".
